snippet.title: Divergence: Fracture | Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Divergence: Fracture is OUT NOW in Early Access on the Epic Games Store!

https://store.epicgames.com/p/divergence-fracture-4e90ad

Fast-paced tactical space combat built around armor penetration, internal modules, missiles, sensors, positioning and multiplayer arena battles.

Early Access is planned to be pretty short, with ship Doctrines/Loadouts, new weapons, new builds, more content and further polish on the way to 1.0.

#indiegame #gamedev
